facts.value: The University Computing Center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.

The telephone hotline of Goethe University helps with questions regarding application, semester dates, re-registration, change of subject, double studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation, among others.
The Central Student Advising offers assistance with questions around applications, semester dates, re-registration, change of subject, double studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.

International Student Services provide international students with information on topics like residence permits, German courses, financing, successful studying, careers, and more. They also offer advice and support.

The Student Welfare Office supports students in social and economic matters. It ensures the necessary infrastructure in areas like student housing, dining halls, cafeterias, and consulting services to help students study successfully.
